load_policies: load policies from a configuration dictionary into the PolicyRegistry singleton
add_policy_to_db: add a new policy version to the database with guardrails, conditions, and pipeline config
sync_policies_from_db: sync production and draft/published policies from the database into the in-memory registry
get_policy_by_id_for_request: resolve a policy version by ID from the in-memory cache without database access
get_policy_registry: get the global PolicyRegistry singleton instance for policy management
